mechanism_card.hypothesis: Reverse arm: spreading mass into low-prior blocks loses DTI under the clustering hypothesis. It wins only if the completeness mechanism dominates -- high-q blocks are already captured by USGS/INGENIOUS mapping (masked from labels), so undiscovered faults disproportionately remain where the field and the catalogue are quiet.
mechanism_card.mechanism: Mirror construction of conc-t25 (same donor/recipient block sets, roles swapped, same pool/selector/spacing), giving a signed dose pair at equal moved count.
mechanism_card.non_fault_mimic: Low-q blocks may be low because thick Quaternary cover hides scarps (blind faults present but field-blind) -- the genuine signal this arm hopes for if it wins; mimicked by playa/evaporite lineaments in the same basins.
mechanism_card.falsifier: Live >= both CONC receipts: the km block prior is anti-informative for NEW-fault labels; allocation should flatten or invert the prior (completeness beats clustering).
